prose: Anthropic is considering releasing a new AI model to counter OpenAI's momentum since the launch of GPT-6 Astra, Reuters reports. The deliberations come ahead of a possible IPO and after CEO Dario Amodei's public call for a slowdown in the AI race.
highlights: Anthropic weighs a new model release to answer OpenAI's momentum since Astra's launch.
The discussions come ahead of an anticipated IPO.
They follow Amodei's call for a slowdown, creating a notable tension.
